description: Dreamwalker Headpiece Level 60 Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Headpiece if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Headpiece, 15 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals. Requirements: - Desecrated Headpiece - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 15 - Cured Rugged Hide x 6 - Nexus Crystal x 2
name: Dreamwalker Headpiece
